about: Declares what it takes to move between released versions of DockVault. Every release must appear here before it can be cut; the release workflow refuses otherwise. Edges are declared between ADJACENT releases only -- a longer upgrade is composed by walking them in order, rather than being asserted as a single hop nobody tested.

kinds.direct: The upgrade can be taken in one step. Any caveats are listed in the edge's conditions.
kinds.blocked: The upgrade must not be taken. The edge says why, and what to do instead.

0.10.0.notes: No schema change. Every release up to here shares one physical schema: the set of boot DDL statements is byte-identical across all of them, and the model differs only in comment text.

0.11.0.notes: First release to change the physical schema: adds the vault_storage_grants table and a nullable users.storage_quota_bytes column, applied automatically and idempotently at boot. The additions are unused by 0.10.0, so a rollback is clean; take a backup before upgrading.

0.11.1.notes: No schema change; same physical schema as 0.11.0. Security patch: user-controlled values (the failed-login redis key and the alert resolver) are sanitized before they reach the security-monitor logs (log-injection hardening). A rollback is clean and needs no backup.

0.11.2.notes: No schema change; same physical schema as 0.11.0/0.11.1. Security hardening: closes a temporary-credential mint vault-password oracle (vault membership is now verified before the password proof), audits admin-plane and cross-tenant access denials, bounds client-supplied encrypted-name metadata, orders the user-update authorization check before the existence lookup, and re-checks temporary-credential deactivation on the web path every request. A rollback is clean and needs no backup.

0.12.0.notes: No schema change; same physical schema as 0.11.0/0.11.1/0.11.2. Adds credential lock/unlock/change-passphrase plus start/stop/restart/status lifecycle commands to the dockvault.py host management tool, so an operator can seal the .env secrets file into an encrypted .env.enc while a deployment is off (envelope encryption: a Fernet data key wrapped under a scrypt-derived passphrase key, with a stable recovery key). This is a host-tool change only; the container image is functionally unchanged from 0.11.2. Also hardens the test suite. A rollback is clean and needs no backup.
